summary: Backend-only testing of the user-selectable Financial Year feature on the GP Profile Crawler API. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_fy_selection.py covering 8 tests. All 8 PASSED against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified: GET /api/config returns financial_year/label/value + crawler; POST /api/financial-year with (2324,'2023 - 2024') and (2526,'2025 - 2026') correctly derives labels '2023-2024' and '2025-2026' via whitespace stripping; GET /api/config and GET /api/summary reflect the newly set FY; GET /api/export?scope=all returns a valid .xlsx file whose Content-Disposition filename uses the current FY (e.g. GP_Contact_Data_2025-2026.xlsx); GET /api/records, /api/errors, /api/crawl/status return valid JSON with state='idle'; POST /api/reset returns {ok:true} when idle. FY restored to default 2425/'2024 - 2025' at end via module teardown.

minor.issue: When the crawler worker is blocked on the (unreachable) live site, /api/crawl/stop returns {ok:true} but the state remains 'stopping' indefinitely — only a backend restart clears it. Non-blocking on this environment but a transition-timeout / forceful task cancellation would make the API more robust. Pre-existing, not caused by the FY-selection change.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/export: Filename suffixing uses base.replace('.xlsx', f'_{scope}.xlsx') which would silently misbehave if excel_filename() ever lacks '.xlsx'. Minor robustness nit.
crawler stop path can leave manager.state='stopping' permanently when the worker is blocked on an unreachable host — consider a hard-cancel with timeout. Out of scope for the FY feature.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests do not insert records; they only toggle FY and read endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. Use `-n 0` to run tests serially when a suite needs ordered FY state. If the public URL returns timeouts, the crawler may be stuck in state='stopping' (because live site gpims.wb.gov.in is firewalled from the container) — restart backend via supervisorctl to clear. Live-site endpoints (/api/analyze, /discover, /test-gp, /crawl/start, /crawl/retry-failed, /financial-years) must NOT be exercised in this env.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests after setup. Initial public-URL timeout was due to a leftover crawl task from a prior session that put the manager into state='running'; a backend supervisor restart cleared the stuck Playwright task and all tests then passed in 1.5s.
